suite: V2.4.6 — Android Billing Readiness & CI Diagnosis
note: V2.4.6 adds 3 new suites on top of V2.4.5's 102: (1) verify rejects missing productId from Google response, (2) restore rejects missing productId from Google response, (3) restore catches concurrent revocation after Google verification (TOCTOU fix). Consolidated 6 PlayBilling serverless functions into single router to fix Vercel Hobby plan 12-function limit. Android BillingClient bridge implemented with WebView-based PlayBillingBridge.kt — compilation requires Android SDK (not available in CI environment). All handler-level tests with mock Redis and Google API doubles pass.
